planets.name: TOI-1408 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1408 with a 2.22-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-1408 c was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1408. Its orbit and size follow Korth et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
